text: [{"claim":"A newly deployed orders service release (rc1) introduced a regression that fails to null-check order payloads, causing NoneType.sku errors during payload normalization.","mechanism":"The rc1 build changed order payload handling but does not guard against missing/None fields; when 'sku' is absent or the object is None, normalization throws an unhandled exception, aborting request processing and causing 502s to propagate upstream to gateway and payment steps.","confidence":0.75,"verification":{"kind":"log_check","params":{"signal":"logs","filter_expression":"service.name = 'orders' AND body CONTAINS 'NoneType' AND body CONTAINS 'sku'"},"expected":{"op":"contains","value":"normalizing order payload","description":"Confirms the NoneType sku normalization error is present and attributable to the orders service post-deploy"}}},{"claim":"The orders service is returning 5xx errors on order processing, which cascades into checkout payment failures and gateway 502s.","mechanism":"When orders fails to normalize the payload it returns an error status; the payment step (dependent on order data) then fails with HTTP errors, and the gateway's checkout call ultimately times out or receives a 502 from the failing chain.","confidence":0.6,"verification":{"kind":"query_range","params":{"signal":"traces","aggregation":"count()","filter_expression":"service.name = 'orders' AND status_code = 5"},"expected":{"op":"ratio_gt","value":5,"description":"5xx error count for orders after the deploy boundary is at least 5x the count before it"}}},{"claim":"Gateway's checkout endpoint is failing due to an upstream orders service outage, evidenced by 502s specifically on the 'http send' span to orders.","mechanism":"Gateway proxies checkout requests to orders; when orders throws unhandled exceptions on payload normalization, the connection is reset or times out, causing gateway to log a 502 on its outbound HTTP send span.","confidence":0.55,"verification":{"kind":"trace_check","params":{"signal":"traces","filter_expression":"service.name = 'gateway' AND name = 'POST /api/checkout http send' AND http.status_code = 502"},"expected":{"op":"contains","value":"orders","description":"The 502 gateway spans correlate with calls to the orders service that is failing"}}},{"claim":"A downstream payment service dependency is intermittently rejecting requests, independent of the orders payload bug, contributing to the observed error rate.","mechanism":"Payment failures logged with generic HTTP status suggest a separate fault in the payment integration (e.g., timeout or auth failure) that compounds the orders-side regression, inflating the overall error rate beyond what the NoneType bug alone would cause.","confidence":0.3,"verification":{"kind":"log_check","params":{"signal":"logs","filter_expression":"service.name = 'orders' AND body CONTAINS 'payment failed for order'"},"expected":{"op":"contains","value":"HTTP","description":"Confirms distinct payment-failure log signature exists and is tied to specific HTTP status codes indicating an independent payment-path fault"}}}]
